name: 迷迷箱怪
evolution: 小箱怪 → 迷迷箱怪 Lv.36
description: 它们并不追逐也不恐吓，只是静静地埋伏，等待小洛克伸手想要开宝箱时，才会突然袭击。因此老练的魔法师们会说：“冒险不难，难的是抵达终点时敢不敢伸手。”
descriptionEn: They neither chase nor threaten; they simply lie quietly in ambush, striking suddenly only when a young Loke reaches out to open the treasure chest. That is why seasoned magicians say: “Adventuring is not the hard part; the hard part is whether you dare reach out when you arrive at the end.”

skills.name: 杠杆置换
skills.description: 自己回复2能量，交换两侧技能位置。
skills.descriptionEn: Self recovers 2 energy, swaps the positions of the skills on both sides.

skills.name: 粒子对撞
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 能量守恒
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：两侧技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; counters attacks: the energy cost of the skills on both sides is permanently -1.

skills.name: 离子震荡
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能位于3号位时威力+40，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when this skill is in slot 3, power +40; transmission 1.

skills.name: 啮合传递
skills.description: 自己获得速度+30，本技能位于1号或3号位时额外获得物攻+80%，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains Speed +30; when this skill is in slot 1 or 3, additionally gains Physical ATK +80%; transmission 1.

skills.name: 星云漩涡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 星链
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击使敌方获得1层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit gives the enemy 1 layer of Starfall Mark.

skills.name: 主轴
skills.description: 造成物伤，此技能位置不会改变。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the position of this skill will not change.

skills.name: 冥想
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：敌方获得2层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; counters attacks: the enemy gains 2 layers of Starfall Mark.

skills.name: 磁暴
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时威力+30，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when this skill is in slot 1 or 3, power +30; transmission 1.

skills.name: 轮班
skills.description: 造成物伤，传动1，选择：本技能位于1号位时威力+65或本回合额外传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, transmission 1; choose: when this skill is in slot 1, power +65, or gain an additional transmission 1 this turn.

skills.name: 双星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 齿轮切开
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能位于1号或3号位时能耗-2，传动1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when this skill is in slot 1 or 3, energy cost -2; transmission 1.

skills.name: 错乱
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：敌方获得3层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; counters status: the enemy gains 3 layers of Starfall Mark.
